Hi Kajal, welcome! It's great to meet you.  Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. I reviewed your resume and was particularly impressed with your projects, especially the Java-based inventory management system and the web-based expense tracker.  They showcase a nice range of skills.

To get started, could you please tell me a little about yourself, your background, and what kind of roles you're interested in pursuing?

Okay, Kajal,  "hello hello" is a bit brief.  Could you tell me a little more about yourself, your background, and what kind of role you're hoping to find?  What are you looking for in a first job after graduating?
I want to become a software developer

That's great, Kajal.  Software development is a broad field.  Given your experience with Java,  HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, and your interest in data structures as demonstrated by your inventory management system, what specific area within software development are you most interested in pursuing – for example, front-end, back-end, full-stack, or something else?
I am interested in full stack developer

Okay, Kajal,  you mentioned wanting to be a full-stack developer.  Your projects show proficiency in both back-end (Java with MySQL) and front-end (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) technologies.  Can you describe a challenging problem you encountered while developing either the Inventory Management System or the Expense Tracker, and how you approached solving it?

Kajal, thank you so much for taking the time to speak with me today.  I've truly enjoyed learning more about your experience and skills; you've provided us with some valuable insights.  The team will now review all the applications, and we will be in touch to let you know the next steps in the process.  We appreciate you considering [Company Name], and wish you all the best.
